summary: KB write-backs are searchable at once (TC4 self-learning without a reset)
description:
Source: KB review 2026-11-04 (P2).

**Today:** `confluence_write` creates the page only. The page reaches pgvector only when `reset_demo.py` runs `ingest-confluence`, so run 2 can't find run 1's post-mortem inside the demo.

**Want:** after an approved `confluence_write` (or the local-folder write, ANVIL-60), ingest that one page into the KB. `store.ingest()` already updates changed documents. The ingest keeps the leak guard and the page's date.

**Acceptance:** run 1 writes a post-mortem; a `kb_search` straight after returns it, with no reset step.

comments.body: [devin] PR #95 up: https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/pull/95 — every written page (local folder or real Confluence) goes through store.ingest immediately, so run 2's kb_search finds run 1's post-mortem without reset_demo.py. Leak guard preserved via store.ingest. Best-effort flag kb_indexed on the result.

[claude] Done. Merged as 5412414 (PR #95, with ANVIL-60).

Acceptance ("run 1 writes a post-mortem; a `kb_search` straight after returns it, with no reset step"): `tests/test_local_knowledge.py::test_a_written_page_is_found_by_kb_search_straight_after` writes a page through `LocalKnowledge` into a real pgvector store and finds it with `store.search` at once; it runs in CI (not skipped). Every written page is ingested immediately (`kb_indexed` is reported in the tool result; a KB outage never fails the write).

The Atlassian path (`confluence_write` / `publish_evidence` with Atlassian configured) now ingests the page it wrote too, dated with `created_at` and logging a warning on failure. That path has no test against a real Confluence; it is the same `store.ingest` call, unit-covered through the recording store. Worth one real check in the dry run if the laptop has Atlassian access.

[devin] Merged as 5412414 (PR #95). Acceptance: every written page (local folder or real Confluence) is store.ingest'ed at once, so run 2's kb_search finds run 1's post-mortem without reset_demo.py; created_at stamped on both paths so dated pages respect the as_of leak guard; kb_indexed flag on the result.
